data.name: OurStoryParagraph1
data.value: iD! Training & Development is the result of a successful partnership between Dominique Heemels and Patrick Stritzko. Though we come from different backgrounds, our collaboration has proven that we complement each other, creating a strong, focused, and effective team. Our differences help us identify and address gaps in our own approaches—just as we do for others.

data.name: OurStoryParagraph2
data.value: We work with businesses, teams, and individuals to uncover blind spots and facilitate growth. Our varied experiences, both personal and professional, have shaped us, and we’re passionate about sharing the lessons we've learned to help others avoid unnecessary challenges. We believe every experience is a gift, and we’re here to guide you through your journey of development.

data.name: ApproachTitle
data.value: What you can expect from us

data.name: ApproachIntro
data.value: And no coach standing above you. At iD! you work on equal footing, not with someone who claims to know better.

data.name: ApproachStep1ShortTitle
data.value: We go straight to the core

data.name: ApproachStep1Title
data.value: We go straight to the core

data.name: ApproachStep1Description
data.value: No lengthy intake forms or non-committal small talk. In the very first conversation, we work together to figure out what's really going on and what you actually need; not what the textbook prescribes.

data.name: ApproachStep2Title
data.value: We make it fit you, not the other way around

data.name: ApproachStep2Description
data.value: You'll work with our tried-and-tested programs, and where needed, we develop something specifically for you or your team. Every goal, whether it's a language level, a career question, a team that wants to communicate better, or a company that wants to grow, calls for its own approach.

data.name: ApproachStep3Description
data.value: Progress, not perfection, is the goal. You'll notice improvement quickly, and that's what keeps the motivation going. Making mistakes is allowed! In fact, it's required (and honestly, it's usually pretty fun too).

data.name: ApproachStep4Title
data.value: We stay involved and adjust as we go

data.name: ApproachStep4Description
data.value: Development isn't a straight line. We evaluate along the way and make adjustments where needed, until it truly works for you.

data.name: ApproachAside
data.value: And through all of these steps, we like to have a bit of fun along the way too; humor and a good laugh work wonders for motivation and results!

data.name: ApproachWhyParagraph1
data.value: We've overhauled our own lives more than once: a different country, a different language, a different existence. We use that experience as our compass in everything we do, not as an anecdote. We know what it feels like to be new somewhere, to doubt yourself, to start over. And how good it feels when it finally clicks.

data.name: ApproachWhyParagraph2
data.value: Whether you're learning Dutch, working on your communication, want to get to know yourself better, or want to help your team move forward: our approach is the same everywhere. Personal, effective, and with humor wherever we can fit it in.
